roles.purpose_zh: 收集 Obsidian、微信日报、文章素材和 GitHub 项目状态。
roles.purpose: Collect new local inputs from Obsidian, WeChat daily outputs, article drafts, and GitHub project state.

roles.purpose_zh: 把收集到的内容生成每日学习卡片、群日报摘要和专题沉淀。
roles.purpose: Generate daily learning cards, group digest summaries, and topic notes from collected inputs.

roles.purpose_zh: 把素材转成公众号草稿、X 长文、小红书笔记和配图提示词。
roles.purpose: Turn source material into WeChat article drafts, X long posts, Xiaohongshu notes, and image prompts.

roles.purpose_zh: 做事实核查、去 AI 味、标题优化、隐私和发布前检查。
roles.purpose: Check facts, remove AI-sounding phrasing, improve titles, and run privacy/publication review.

roles.purpose_zh: 维护本地和已发布的 Codex Skills，包括 SKILL.md、脚本、示例和 README 定位。
roles.purpose: Maintain local and published Codex skills: SKILL.md quality, scripts, examples, README positioning.
never: edit skills without explicit follow-up authorization

roles.purpose_zh: 运行本地检查、README 校验、安全扫描、产物存在性检查和发布前验收报告。
roles.purpose: Run local checks, README validation, security scans, output existence checks, and release readiness reports.
